messages:
Alex R.: Hey team — need a short console elevation to scrub a handful of telemetry entries that contain PII. Will only touch the telemetry namespace (redact: user_email, user_name). Planning a 45m window starting ~now.
Alex R.: Justification: privacy bug in ingestion pipeline caused emails to be logged for ~2hrs, need to run the redaction job and validate no tail logs remain.
Maria (SRE): @Alex R. thanks — can you paste the exact commands and the ticket/PR this ties to? Need that for audit. Also what's the minimum role you need?
Alex R.: Ticket: ENG-4921 (privacy-scrub). PR: https://git.company/infra/telemetry-scrub/pull/8
Alex R.: Commands: ```bash
# run in prod-readonly session, then escalate for redact job
telemetry-cli query --env prod --filter "ingest_time>2026-03-17" --fields id,raw_payload > /tmp/suspect.ndjson
telemetry-cli redact --input /tmp/suspect.ndjson --redact-fields user_email,user_name --commit
```
Alex R.: I only need console sudo for the redact job and to tail the redact logs (/var/log/telemetry/redact.log). No DB schema or migration work.
Sam K.: @Alex R. can you confirm the redact tool writes an audit record per-file and we'll retain the scrub metadata? We need that on the ticket.
Alex R.: yes — redact tool appends to /var/audit/telemetry-redact.log and emits a JSON audit record to kinesis. PR adds a checksum proof.
Jordan (oncall): Prefer 30m window + 30m validation. Who's approving? @Maria to OK or @security-team?
Maria (SRE): I can approve the window. Approving 1h total (30m redact + 30m validation). Please make sure the session uses just-in-time elevation and set expiry.
sec-approvals-bot: request submitted: route=https://internal-approvals/requests/8943, requested_by=Alex R., role=prod-console-sudo, duration=1h
sec-approvals-bot: approval granted by Maria (SRE) at 1768504385. session_id=apr-8943-temp
Maria (SRE): Alex — session apr-8943-temp will expire automatically. Remember to tag all commands with `# ENG-4921` in logs.
Sam K.: Adding: please run a quick grep after redact: `grep -E "user_email|user_name" /var/log/telemetry/* || echo OK` and paste output to the ticket.
Alex R.: Will do. Starting shortly, will post status updates. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
sec-approvals-bot: audit-note: elevation apr-8943-temp started by Alex R. at 1768504400, will expire at 1768508000
Alex R.: Completed redact and validation. Grep returned no matches. Pushed audit artifacts to ENG-4921. Marking thread resolved. Thanks everyone! :white_check_mark:
